prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 4K ultra-realistic retro-inspired fashion editorial portrait of an adult woman against a soft beige background. She wears a vintage-style sleeveless fruit-print dress with a white collar like a scarf detail and large mango and apple prints. On her head is a decorative large red hat with apple motifs and pink roses wrapped around the rim. She holds the juice pack from the reference image near her lips with a straw. Use an elegant pose, confident expression, red lipstick and softly curled hair styled in a classic retro wave. Clean studio background, soft lighting, vibrant yet balanced color palette, sharp focus, high-fashion advertising photography, surreal fruit styling, ultra-detailed, cinematic lighting, professional product shoot, hyper-realistic 4K image in a 4:5 frame.
